# Original Buttonwood wildlife archive

Preserved October 10, 2026 before the Critz Tower Defense character exploration.

The original **bird, butterfly, worm, mole, rabbit, and firefly** designs are saved
in `native-animals-cages.png`. `wildlife.js` preserves their native poses, icons,
animal buckets, and cages; `palette.js` preserves the exact palette. The original
`game-v71-wildlife.txt` and `BIOMES-WILDLIFE.md` preserve integration and behavior
context. These are archival copies, not loaded game modules.

The live wildlife implementation remains available and existing saves retain
all animals. This snapshot allows future character migration without losing the
original mole, worm, or any other animal artwork.
